name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.CircuitSAT.BruteForceExplicit.submissionProp
title: Submission proposition of the explicit-cost brute-force WE submission
statement: The brute-force witness-encryption submission for NAND-circuit SAT with explicit tape-program machines and explicit cost bound N (about 2^188) satisfies the Submission proposition of WE_CircuitSAT: it is correct and false-statement secure with no premises, and its cost is at most N.
